sentences.en: I like all sorts of Asian foods, particularly Thai food.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢各种亚洲食物，尤其是泰国菜。

sentences.en: The African elephant has bigger ears than the Asian elephant.
sentences.zh: 非洲象的耳朵比亚洲象的大。

sentences.en: Marika is Finnish, but she looks like an Asian girl.
sentences.zh: 玛丽卡是芬兰人，但她看起来像一个亚洲女孩。
